title: This is the best produced theatre cast album of the last two decades ...
transcript: so I just got done listening to the cast recording of Here We Are the final Stephen Sondheim score and I could not get over how pleasant on the ears the score was and I started to think about why and I think it's because Stephen Sondheim is writing are performers natural vocal tones and it's not like most musical theatre scores now which seem to only exist to see who can hit the highest notes possible and this bombardment of the highest note possible as many times as possible in new musical theatre scores has been both at the detriment of the performers vocal health and of the audience's sonic experience in my opinion or whatever the score for water for elephants was I forgot it as soon as I listened to it it feels like so many new musical theatre scores are not worried about musicality are definitely not worried about lyrics but are only worried about writing in as many ridiculously high belted notes as possible and it's so refreshing to hear a new musical theatre score that stays as far away from that as possible and I wish this was the lesson that new musical theatre writers took from Stephen Sondheim as they all try to rip him off continually with their work it's also not lost on me the content of here we are and how prophetic it seems it seems like Sondheim was telling us what was about to happen from beyond the grave I saw one of here we are first previews October 5th and the next day is probably what's going to be considered the day that started the end the end of the world possibly and the end of the world starting because of the 1 percent's greed is something that's going on outside and something that was going on in the world of the show directly before it was going on outside of the theatre 🎶welcome to the end of the world🎶 thank you, Stephen Sondheim, for going out giving us a score with natural vocal tones, that featured a character that had a f00t thing, and that featured lyrics about Tesla Mountain Dew and Bitcoin. we truly truly truly never deserved you, you absolute king among men
